name: Breadcrumb-Crusted Halibut with Mushroom-Spinach Sauté & Quinoa

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, mix together lemon juice, bread crumbs, dill, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 tbsp gluten-free bread crumbs
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place halibut in a small baking dish. Drizzle with a little olive oil and top with bread crumb mixture, patting lightly to help it adhere.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g halibut fillet
extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place dish in the oven and bake until fish is white and flaky, 10-12 minutes. Change setting to broil and continue baking until bread crumb mixture turns golden brown, 1-2 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and mince garlic. Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry spinach. Add to mushrooms and toss until just wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place quinoa on a plate, add spinach-mushroom sauté, and top with halibut fillet. Enjoy!
